To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of Spam Filtering techniques is very much dependent on the type of data set, the size of the data set, and the type of algorithm used.
the Naive Bayes algorithm performs the best among the algorithms considered.
SVMs are the best spam filters, followed by Bayes, lazy algorithms and neural networks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
finding out the best machine learning algorithm for spam e-mail filtering.
the development and testing of an e-mail classification model using various machine learning techniques and to determine the most accurate model for the classification of spam e-mail corpus.
the performance of various supervised machine learning techniques for classifying spam emails.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Support Vector Machines (SVMs) outperformed all the other techniques in the classification of the e-mail corpus.
the Support Vector Machine is the best classifier among the supervised machine learning algorithms.
the performance of the spam filtering system can be improved by using different combinations of the machine learning algorithms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of all the algorithms is good but the performance of the neural network is best.
the best performance is achieved by using a combination of different machine learning techniques for the spam e-mail filtering.
the best results are achieved by the support vector machines (SVM) and neural networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
spam filtering is an active area of research and there is no best method for spam filtering as the performance of the algorithms depends on the nature of the dataset and the features selected.
spam filtering is not a trivial task and it requires a lot of effort and time to develop a model that is able to detect spam e-mails with high accuracy.
, the accuracy of spam classification depends upon the type of the algorithm.
